title: Haikyuu!! Anime Canon Question Bank
adaptationBoundary: Includes only the officially released Haikyuu!! television anime Seasons 1–4, released continuity OAD/OVA episodes, and the released 2024 film HAIKYU!! The Dumpster Battle. Recap films are referenced only as released anime materials, not treated as new events. Excludes manga-only matches, post-anime manga outcomes, unreleased announced films/specials, and non-canon or promotional material.
notes: All prompts are original wording and each has one objectively correct answer.
Episode references use season/episode ranges or released-special labels where an arc spans multiple episodes.
The bank does not use the announced but unreleased VS 小さな巨人 or バケモノたちの行くところ projects as evidence.
All retained source records are marked verified; review_count is zero.
